common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent combat VFX sprite for a dark fantasy party RPG, square 1024x1024. This is an effect appearing over an existing character portrait, never a skill icon, item, character or badge.
Rendering: bold clean hand-drawn cartoon graphic shapes, uniformly thick very dark charcoal outlines #0B060C, flat base color with ONE flat shadow step and a small pale highlight. Limited muted palette. Matches chunky illustrated dark-fantasy warriors and cartoon flame-effect sprites. No realistic texture, no 3D, no painterly strokes, no soft gradients, no neon, no bloom, no lens flare, no smoky backdrop.
Framing: exactly one effect composition centered in the canvas. All visible content inside the central 84 percent with an 8 percent fully transparent margin on all sides. Few large readable shapes for display at 85-100 pixels for half a second. Large transparent spaces must keep the underlying portrait visible.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background, NO background color, NO baked checkerboard, NO text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO runes, NO watermark, NO frame, NO icon badge, NO faces, NO body, NO armor item, NO weapons, NO landscape, NO solid ground plane.

skills.name: 배시
skills.subject: Exactly THREE parallel long straight DIAGONAL slash streaks running from upper left to lower right, like the existing warrior's white-tiger three-slash attack. Broad ivory-white cores with a muted pale sky-blue outer rim and dark outline. Each streak has a sharp taper at both ends and a thicker middle. Thick clear transparent gaps separate all three. Strong, clean, mostly straight strokes; no X, no curves, no blood, no paws, no tiger head. One triple slash effect as a single image.

skills.name: 더블스윙
skills.subject: Exactly TWO broad straight diagonal slash streaks crossing in a clear X at the canvas center. Ivory-white blade-light cores, muted pale sky-blue rims and bold dark outlines. One diagonal from upper left to lower right, the other from upper right to lower left. Crisp tapered points, balanced four arms. ONE compact small pale impact flash at the crossing, not a big explosion. Transparent gaps around all arms reveal the portrait. No weapons, no triple parallel strokes, no circular aura.

skills.name: 어스스플릿
skills.subject: A broad LOW horizontal earth-splitting impact composition occupying the lower-middle canvas, with THREE thick branching jagged fissures spreading outward from a central impact and FIVE short chunky stone spikes kicking up along the fissures. The fissures are graphic dark brown strips edged with muted ochre highlights, suspended as effect marks on transparency rather than a solid slab or landscape. The short stones are earthy taupe with a single brown shadow plane and small pale chipped edge. Wide horizontal silhouette, broken zigzag rhythm, open center. No lightning, no fire, no axe, no background ground.

skills.name: 리프 어택
skills.subject: ONE broad short VERTICAL silver-white impact streak descending straight from the upper center toward a landing point in the lower center. Below it exactly TWO broad LOW elliptical shockwave rings spread horizontally from that point, muted earthy ochre and pale stone edges. Three small chunky stone flecks along the ring edges. The vertical descending line and low landing rings are unmistakable and transparent inside. Clean flat cartoon colors and dark outlines. No parabolic jumping arrow, no figure, no weapon, no branching cracks, no spiral vortex.

skills.name: 타운트
skills.subject: Exactly TWO broken circular crimson rings closing inward around an EMPTY fully transparent center, like an aggressive challenge focusing enemy attention on the wearer. Four broad hooked inward-facing arc tips visually draw toward the center; thick muted dark crimson bands with a flat burgundy shadow step and small dusty-red highlights. Rings have big clear gaps, not a solid red disk. Shape is compact, tense, enclosing, very readable. No face, no exclamation mark, no speech bubble, no monster, no spikes, no bloody droplets, no magic glyph.

skills.name: 워 크라이

skills.name: 배틀오더스

skills.name: 아이언 스킨
skills.subject: ONE protective STEEL SHELL contour around an entirely EMPTY transparent oval center. The outline suggests two broad shoulder-like steel plates above and layered side bands enclosing an invisible torso, but is only an effect border, not an actual armor item or person. Muted steel-gray plates with a single slate-blue shadow and pale silver edge highlight. Three or four very large simple plate segments, generous transparent openings between them; the interior stays completely open to show the underlying character portrait. Stable, heavy, symmetric protection; no shield prop, no head, no body, no face, no chest filling, no rune, no spark storm.
